data.exact_reserve_text: The prior year development is calculated from the 'Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred' table on page 45 by comparing the ultimate estimates for underwriting years 2014-2020 at 31 December 2022 against their respective ultimate estimates at 31 December 2021.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The reserve held at the end of 2021 has deteriorated slightly during 2022. Gross reserves have reduced, but there has been a larger reduction to the level of recoveries due from this event, leading to the net reserve being a little higher.

Major Hurricane Ida was our largest event. The path of the storm has impacted several key population centres of Louisiana and as such will be a significant personal lines loss. Given the more regional nature of our portfolio, we support a number of the local carriers and were impacted accordingly. Despite the level of catastrophe activity continuing unabated we are expecting the year will close at a profit.
Exposure to other major events such as the major European Storms and Floods (Bernd) and Winter Freeze Uri have been modest.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2022 financial year, Syndicate 1729 experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 14.707 million, representing 7.59% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was primarily driven by economic inflation impacting claims costs, adverse development on prior accident years, and natural catastrophe events. Specific events from prior years, such as the ongoing impact of COVID-19, the Ukraine conflict, Max Air loss, Hurricane Ida, European Storms and Floods (Bernd), and Winter Freeze Uri, contributed to the overall development. The claims development table on page 45 indicates movements across underwriting years 2014-2020.

data.data_quality_notes: The 2020 Year of Account closed by Reinsurance to Close (RITC) into 2021. The prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, which reflects incurred development for the 2020 YOA despite its RITC closure.
